label: SYNTHETIC-DEMO
description: Main-flow integration fixture: availability -> feasibility -> planner -> adapter -> projected scorer -> real SP2 engine, then replan, what_if_skip and a keep conflict. Student, activities, evidence and bindings are synthetic; rules are the real data/drl_rules.json. Not real student data and not university-verified scores.

upstream.how: availability_response and feasibility_response were produced by running the real resolve_availability and assess_feasibility at this commit on availability_request / feasibility_request with this trusted evidence. They are stored unchanged and are consumed verbatim by the planner.

derivation: Baseline facts (same as synthetic_scoring_data.json): R11 -> C1 15, R19 1 seminar x5 -> C1 20; R21 -> C2 15; R37 10 + R33 1x5 -> C3 15; R41 -> C4 10; C5 0; total 60.
Bindings: SEM-A/B/C and QUIZ-M add one R19 seminar (C1 +5 each, cap 30); QUIZ-L adds one R46 activity (C4 +10); MOB-W, REG-Z add one R33 activity (C3 +5 each, cap 25).

Step 1 free time: Mon 08-12, Wed 07-13, Thu 13-17, Sat 08-12. SEM-A Mon 09-10 and SEM-B Mon 09:30-11 overlap -> conflict pair. NEWS-X is online without evidence -> NEEDS_REVIEW. DONE-Y is COMPLETED -> INFEASIBLE, not in the baseline -> pending_confirmation. REG-Z is REGISTERED, so its passed deadline is ignored.

Targets C1 30, C4 20, total 80 need two seminars and QUIZ-L, so no plan of size 1 or 2 meets them. Size-3 plans that meet them: {SEM-x, QUIZ-M, QUIZ-L} for x in A, B, C. All have 2 online matches; minutes A 60+180+90 = 330, B 360, C 330; A beats C on the sorted ID list.

Scheduling (counterexample to a fixed window-end order): QUIZ-L (window Wed 09-12, 90 min) placed first at 09:00 leaves no 180-minute gap for QUIZ-M; the exact schedule is QUIZ-M Wed 07:00-10:00 then QUIZ-L Wed 10:00-11:30.
Step 1 attribution in scheduled order SEM-A, QUIZ-M, QUIZ-L: C1 20->25->30, C4 10->20. Projected 30/15/15/20/0 = 80, TARGET_MET.

Step 1 search without a previous plan: 7 eligible (SEM-A, SEM-B, SEM-C, QUIZ-L, QUIZ-M, MOB-W, REG-Z), one conflict pair, every conflict-free set schedulable. Scored subsets 1 + 7 + (21-1) + (35-5) = 58; size 4 is dominated, so complete=false with optimality proven.
Step 2: the student adds busy Mon 09:00-10:00 and Wed 10:00-10:30 and has registered SEM-A. SEM-A and SEM-B leave available time -> INFEASIBLE. Previous plan P = {SEM-A, QUIZ-M, QUIZ-L}.

Step 2 eligible: SEM-C, QUIZ-L, QUIZ-M, MOB-W, REG-Z. Only {SEM-C, QUIZ-M, QUIZ-L} (or supersets) meets every target; it has 2 activity-set changes, supersets have 3. QUIZ-M keeps Wed 07-10; QUIZ-L's old block now overlaps busy time and moves to the earliest valid Wed 10:30-12:00; SEM-C is added Thu 14-15. SEM-A is dropped NO_LONGER_FEASIBLE and is registered -> DROPS_REGISTERED.
Step 2 search with a previous plan has no dominance pruning: all 2^5 = 32 subsets are schedulable and scored. score_comparison rescores P ∩ eligible = {QUIZ-L, QUIZ-M}: C1 25, C4 20, total 75.

what_if_skip(QUIZ-L) on step 2: no C4 source remains, so the C4 gap of 10 is unavoidable. C1 needs QUIZ-M and SEM-C; total 80 then needs MOB-W and REG-Z (C3 15->25). Unique best {QUIZ-M, MOB-W, SEM-C, REG-Z}; 16 subsets evaluated exhaustively -> PARTIAL, PROVEN_UNREACHABLE. Attribution order QUIZ-M (Wed 07), MOB-W (Thu 13), SEM-C (Thu 14), REG-Z (Thu 15): +5 C1, +5 C3, +5 C1, +5 C3. QUIZ-L dropped CANCELLED, SEM-A dropped NO_LONGER_FEASIBLE. Comparison rescores {QUIZ-M}: C1 25, total 65.
Keep conflict on step 2: KEEP_TIME for QUIZ-L (old block Wed 10:00-11:30 overlaps busy 10:00-10:30 -> BLOCK_INVALID) and SEM-A (INFEASIBLE -> NOT_ELIGIBLE), listed by activity ID.
